title: HumanSamplePlan
description: raw/_provenance/<run_id>/human_sample_plan.json — the ASK half of the human spot-check (A4/B11). A SCRIPT writes this file and nothing else may: it names which high-risk cells a person must open the original and read, chosen by a seed the run cannot influence (sha256(patient_code + sorted field keys), deliberately NOT including run_id, so re-running does not reshuffle the sample until something agrees). The ANSWER half is human_sample_result.json, written by the human. They are two files because one file meant the run chose the sample AND recorded the verdict in the same pass — 「人工抽查通过」 that cost nothing and certified itself. This file is a plan, never evidence: a plan with no result is an unfinished verification and the validator fails it as one.

run_id.description: The run this plan belongs to; matches the raw/_provenance/<run_id>/ directory holding it.

seed.description: The sampling seed actually used, recorded so the selection can be reproduced and shown not to have been chosen after the fact. Per A36 it is sha256(patient_code + sorted(field keys)) and contains no run_id: a sample that changes every run is a sample a run can retry until it likes the answer.

rule.description: The sampling rule in words, e.g. 「每患者 ≥3 个高风险字段或全部高风险字段的 5%，取大者」. Stated here so a reviewer can check the plan against the rule rather than trusting the count.

sample.description: The cells a human must check. MAY be empty only when the archive genuinely has no high-risk field at all; if any source's transcript frontmatter classifies a label as high-risk (scripts/_high_risk.py), an empty sample is a defect and the validator says so.

source_id.description: Must match a source_id in source_inventory.json.

page.description: 1-based page number within the source, as pages.json numbers it.

label.description: The field label AS THE SOURCE PRINTS IT — the same verbatim string as the transcript frontmatter fields[].label and the inventory high_risk_fields[].label, so the three can be joined without fuzzy matching.

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] normalized 0-1, origin top-left, anchored to the raw/ page image — where on the page the checker should look. Never a Markdown line number.

transcript_value.description: What 段 1 read in this cell. It is included ON PURPOSE despite the anchoring risk: a checker asked 「what does this cell say?」 with no reference cannot report a MISMATCH, only a reading, and comparing the two readings afterwards is the same self-certification the split was meant to remove. The mitigation is procedural (the checker reads the original first) and is stated in the rule, not in the schema.
